title: XTRA POWER Cut Off Wheel X3/GX Series, 107/125/180/355MM Diameter, 1.5/1.6/2.8MM Thickness, 16/22.23/25.40MM Arbor Hole, Pack of 10 (180mm Diameter Pack of 10)
description: The XTRA POWER Cut Off Wheel X3/GX Series is a high-performance abrasive wheel designed for precision cutting across a wide range of materials. Available in multiple diameter options — 107mm, 125mm, 180mm, and 355mm — these wheels cater to various cutting requirements, from light-duty tasks to heavy industrial applications. The range also offers flexible thickness choices of 1.5mm, 1.6mm, and 2.8mm, allowing users to select the ideal wheel for clean, accurate cuts with minimal material wastage. Compatibility is ensured through multiple arbor hole sizes — 16mm, 22.23mm, and 25.40mm — making these wheels suitable for use with a broad variety of angle grinders and cutting machines. Each pack contains 10 wheels, ensuring you have an ample supply for extended work sessions. Built to deliver consistent performance, the XTRA POWER Cut Off Wheel X3/GX Series is a reliable choice for metalworkers, fabricators, and construction professionals who demand durability and precision in their cutting tools. Ideal for cutting metal, steel, and other hard materials with efficiency and control.

specifications.Compatible Devices: Angle Grinder, Bench Grinder, Cut-off Machine, Power Cutter
specifications.Special Features: Fast Cutting Action, Low Vibration, Multi-diameter Compatibility, Suitable For Metal And Stainless Steel Cutting, Thin Kerf Design
specifications.Recommended Uses For Product: Cutting Aluminium, Cutting Iron, Cutting Metal, Cutting Non-ferrous Metals, Cutting Pipes, Cutting Profiles, Cutting Rods, Cutting Sheet Metal, Cutting Stainless Steel, Cutting Steel
